segments.name: Home tests
segments.description: Develops and licenses non-invasive home test products for early detection of health anomalies to regional or global licensees.
segments.evidence: Davion Healthcare is a healthcare company focusing on the development and commercialization of non-invasive home tests for the early detection, prevention and monitoring of health anomalies.

revenueModel.text: Licensees pay the company license fees and royalties on products they manufacture or sell under license in their territories.
revenueModel.evidence: Cash flows are expected to be derived primarily from milestone-based license fees and recurring royalty payments tied to the volume of products manufactured and/or sold by licensees.
